articles.title: Help EFF Solve an Issue That's Bigger than Creepy Ads
articles.summary: Microsoft drops 167 vulns including a SharePoint zero-day and Windows Defender's 'BlueHammer' flaw, while Chrome patches its fourth zero-day this year. AI might be finding bugs faster than humans can patch them—terrifying and hilarious.

articles.title: Anti-DDoS Firm Heaped Attacks on Brazilian ISPs
articles.summary: Cybercriminals defaced Canvas login pages with ransom demands, disrupting classes nationwide and proving that even homework isn't safe from extortion. Education gets schooled by hackers once again.

articles.title: A “Scheme” Against Dobbs: SCOTUS Dissent Hints at Next Phase of Abortion Rights Fight
articles.summary: Another CVSS 10.0 Cisco SD-WAN vulnerability gets exploited in the wild—the second perfect score exploit this year. Cisco's having a very bad year, and threat actors are having a field day.

articles.title: Victory! End-to-End Encrypted RCS Comes to Apple and Android Chats
articles.summary: Instagram kills its barely-used end-to-end encryption feature after years of empty promises. Meta continues its proud tradition of prioritizing surveillance capitalism over user privacy.

articles.title: EFF Launches New Offline Campaign for Saudi Wikipedian Osama Khalid
articles.summary: Apple finally delivers end-to-end encryption for RCS messaging between iPhone and Android users. Only took them long enough to stop making our conversations surveillance-friendly by default.

articles.title: MPs want social media treated more like unsafe toys than harmless apps
articles.summary: OpenAI employees got pwned via poisoned npm packages in a supply chain attack that compromised internal credentials. Even the AI overlords can't escape basic security hygiene failures.

articles.title: Grafana GitHub Token Breach Led to Codebase Download and Extortion Attempt
articles.summary: NGINX CVE-2026-42945 heap buffer overflow gets exploited in the wild days after disclosure, causing worker crashes and possible RCE. The web's favorite reverse proxy becomes a forward liability.

articles.title: aegis-atv 0.5.1
articles.summary: AI-assisted researchers discover first Apple M5 memory exploit using Anthropic's Claude, bypassing Memory Integrity Enforcement for root access. The machines are now hacking themselves—peak 2026 energy.

articles.title: ChatGPT Can Now Connect to Your Bank Account and See All Your Transactions
articles.summary: Pwn2Own Berlin 2026 researchers earn nearly $900K for 39 zero-days over two days, with Microsoft Exchange taking a beating. White hats getting paid while vendors get educated—capitalism working as intended.

articles.title: Canvas Hack Aftermath: Congress Wants Instructure to Answer Questions
articles.summary: TeamPCP hackers are auctioning off Mistral AI's source code repos after compromising the French AI startup. Even the Europeans' ChatGPT alternative isn't safe from digital smash-and-grab operations.
